description: Observatory regression limits: all 15 areas use runtime architecture. Total build measured at 3.43 MB after replacing palace bakes; 4.3 MB cap prevents retired assets re-entering the release, with headroom for the optional, dynamically-imported three/webgpu chunk (~162 KB gzip) added alongside the WebGL2 fallback renderer. Source media is streamed and measured separately. Startup JS rose to ~220 KB gzip with the palace's second pass (terrain, stairs, the plaque loader and the portal's intent and shader); the cap is 230 KB. On 2026-09-17 the club and phone dock brought main to 230.3 KB, and the grove-wide controls (point, glide, frame, the plan of rooms; their bodies load on demand, their bindings and the Guide's shared move do not) added 2.6 KB more: startup is ~232.9 KB against a cap of 234 KB, and all JS ~703 KB (the lazy glide, framing, map and repository-model chunks) against 706 KB. The desktop and tablet rail (one panel column for the guide, sources, who is here, the chat and frame timing, #55) adds ~1.9 KB to startup and ~1.2 KB to all JS: ~234.9 KB against a cap of 237 KB, and ~707 KB against 710 KB.
